text:
maria: Quick random question — If you could build a 3-floor treehouse anywhere in the world, where would you put it and what would be on each floor? :deciduous_tree:

jamal: Kyoto, near a bamboo grove. Top floor: telescope + zen nook for sunrise. Middle: tea/reading room. Ground: tiny workshop + tool bench. :herb:

lucas: Rooftop of an old bookstore in Lisbon — floor 1: cat lounge and maps, floor 2: vintage record player + listening corner, floor 3: balcony full of plants and a hammock. :cat: :vinyl:

priya: Icelandic coast cliffside. Floor 3: hot tub and observation deck, floor 2: library with big windows, floor 1: fireplace + board games. Solar panels on the roof. :volcano: :books:

angela: @maria love this idea. Paris, overlooking the Seine — very impractical but romantic. Middle floor has a tiny espresso bar. :croissant:

tom: Somewhere on Redwood HQ grounds? (yes I volunteer to not vacate it) Jokes aside — floor 1: nap pods, floor 2: VR/retro games, floor 3: quiet coding den with no meetings allowed. :zzz:

katie: Festival-mobile treehouse. Build it on a trailer. Floor 1: staging & gear, floor 2: merch + chill, floor 3: greenroom for performers. Tiny fold-out sign that says "Free hugs". :truck: :microphone:

zane: Minimalist under a giant sequoia in Redwood National Park. Each floor is basically a sleeping platform with 360 views — less stuff, more silence. :evergreen_tree:

dev-bot: safety-bot: Reminder: any treehouse built near a worksite must follow safety checklist and submit a hullabaloo mitigation plan. Helmets recommended. :construction:

maria: This is golden. We should have a 10-minute doodle hang and sketch these out Friday. Who's in? :smile:

jamal: I'm in — 10:30am PT works for me. :raised_hands:

priya: Count me in. I will bring snack suggestions for the tiny kitchen. :cookie:

lucas: I'll sketch the Lisbon version. Want to try one of those collaborative whiteboards? :pencil2:

katie: I will make a mock-up sticker that says "Treehouse Ops." :sparkles:

angela: Can we add a tiny soundproof booth for 2AM karaoke? Important question. :microphone:

maria: Noted. 10:30am PT doodle hang — I'll post a calendar invite and a Miro link. :calendar:
